entries.name: The Testerman Family
entries.request: Grieving the loss of Ed's mother this past week. Pray for comfort as the family travels for the service and for peace in the weeks ahead.

entries.name: Dorothy Example
entries.request: Recovering at home after hip replacement surgery. Therapy is going well; she is grateful for every card and asks for continued prayers for patience.

entries.name: Sam Placeholder
entries.request: Beginning a second round of chemotherapy on Monday. Pray for strength, minimal side effects, and calm for his wife and daughters.

entries.name: The Mockingbird Family
entries.request: New job search after a plant closing; two children at home. Pray for provision and a door to open close by.

entries.name: Grace Sampleton
entries.request: Awaiting biopsy results this Thursday. Pray for clear answers and steady hearts whatever the news.

entries.name: Bill and Nancy Fixture
entries.request: Celebrating an answered prayer: Bill's scans came back clear. They give thanks and ask that the list keep praying for the friends they met in treatment.

entries.name: Warren Sample
entries.request: Being treated for prostate cancer. The most recent scan showed it has not spread; the next follow-up is in September. Grateful for steady news and asking for prayers that it stays that way.

entries.name: The Example Twins
entries.request: Both starting at a new school this month after the move; pray for good friends, kind teachers, and settled hearts.

entries.name: Vera Instance
entries.request: Recovering from a stroke; speech therapy twice a week. She could speak slowly at last visit and knew everyone in the room. Pray for continued recovery and for her husband as caregiver.

entries.name: Chuck Demo
entries.request: Out of work since the plant closed and now dealing with a knee that needs surgery before he can take warehouse work. Pray for healing, provision, and patience in the waiting.

entries.name: The Boilerplate Family
entries.request: House fire last month; staying with family while insurance sorts out the rebuild. Nobody was hurt. Pray for the long haul of paperwork and for the kids as school starts.

sections.title: Other Text Requests for Prayer Received

entries.name: A neighbor on Maxham Road
entries.request: Asked for prayer for her marriage. No details shared; the Lord knows the need.

entries.name: Traveler from Wednesday night
entries.request: Texted asking prayer for safe travel to Fort Benning and a good start in a new post.

entries.name: Rosa Placeholder's cousin
entries.request: Waiting on biopsy results after a spot was found on her lung. She lives alone out of state; pray for peace while she waits and for family to be able to travel if needed.

entries.name: A coworker of Sam Placeholder
entries.request: Going through a difficult divorce and worried about custody arrangements for two young children. Pray for wisdom, gentleness, and provision.

entries.name: Marie Stub
entries.request: Unspoken.

entries.name: Flood recovery in the Carolinas
entries.request: For families rebuilding after last month's flooding, and for the volunteer teams our conference is sending this fall.

entries.name: Persecuted churches
entries.request: For congregations who gather at risk, that they would know courage and fellowship.

entries.name: Peace in conflict zones
entries.request: For an end to war, for the protection of civilians, and for the peacemakers.

entries.name: Eleanor Specimen
entries.address: Sweetwater Assisted Living, Room 214, 1200 Example Way, Austell GA 30168

entries.name: Rev. Harold Dummy
entries.request: Recovering from a fall; spirits are good. Loves visitors on Tuesday afternoons.
